messages.author: Johannes Loeffler
messages.body:
Dear all,
I am trying to install amber22 on my work station. When downloading amber22 after extracting the files from the compressed directory the build folder is missing and with it the run_cmake script. Am I missing some step inbetween?
Thank you for your support,
Best Joe

messages.author: Daniel Roe
messages.body:
Hi,
You also need to have AmberTools, which contains the infrastructure
for building Amber.
https://ambermd.org/AmberTools.php
-Dan
